subject.title: Skills: apply tool policy to direct slash dispatch

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78525, or should `vincentkoc` revive it with a rebase that preserves the shipped resolver?
rationale: Automation cannot close MEMBER-authored or `maintainer`-labeled PRs, and the remaining choice is whether the branch has maintainer-owned value beyond the merged successor.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR manually and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78525 plus `v2026.6.11` as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Revive On Main
options.body: Rebase the branch and preserve current main's model, sender, sandbox, subagent, inherited, and declared-allowlist policy handling before any merge consideration.

options.title: Leave Parked
options.body: Leave the PR open as a maintainer-owned record, accepting that it remains conflicting and should not be merged as-is.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR manually and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78525 plus `v2026.6.11` as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is their protected maintainer branch and they are the best-positioned owner to close or revive it.
